name: Question 20
worked_solution:
Applying the quotient rule, using the formula for the derivative of $\operatorname{arctan}⁡x$ and applying the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[\frac{{arctan}^{2}⁡(5x)}{{x}^{2}}] \\  & =\frac{{x}^{2}\cdot 2\cdot \operatorname{arctan}⁡(5x)\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arctan}⁡(5x))-(2x){arctan}^{2}⁡(5x)}{{x}^{4}} \\  & =\frac{2{x}^{2}\cdot \operatorname{arctan}⁡(5x)\cdot \frac{5}{1+(5x)^{2}}-(2x){arctan}^{2}⁡(5x)}{{x}^{4}} \\  & =\frac{10\operatorname{arctan}⁡(5x)}{{x}^{2}(25{x}^{2}+1)}-\frac{2}{{x}^{3}}\cdot {arctan}^{2}⁡(5x).\end{aligned}
$$

Question 20
?

Find f′(x) if f(x)=arctan2⁡(5x)x2.

a
arctan⁡(5x)10x2(25x2+1)+1x3⋅arctan2⁡(5x)
b
arctan⁡(5x)x2(25x2+1)+2x3⋅arctan2⁡(5x)
c
25arctan⁡(5x)x2(10x2+1)−2x3⋅arctan2⁡(5x)
d
10arctan⁡(5x)x2(25x2+1)−2x3⋅arctan2⁡(5x)
e
10arctan⁡(x)x2(5x2+1)−1x3⋅arctan2⁡(5x)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Applying the quotient rule, using the formula for the derivative of arctan⁡x and applying the chain rule, we get

f′(x)=ddx[arctan2⁡(5x)x2]=x2⋅2⋅arctan⁡(5x)⋅ddx(arctan⁡(5x))−(2x)arctan2⁡(5x)x4=2x2⋅arctan⁡(5x)⋅51+(5x)2−(2x)arctan2⁡(5x)x4=10arctan⁡(5x)x2(25x2+1)−2x3⋅arctan2⁡(5x).
